meta.protocol: Leaves get statements only. Agents close them. Unclosed leaves go to pending_decomposition queue for further splitting.

macros.name: DKAM L∞ Non-Increasing (discrete maximum principle + stretching)
sub_claims: (a) diffusion stencil is convex combination → max-preserving

macros.name: Uniform H² Bound via Sharp Discrete Sobolev Embedding
sub_claims: H² monotone non-increasing combining M1 + M2

macros.name: Aubin-Lions Compactness
sub_claims: (i) L²(0,T; H¹) uniform bound from M1
compact embedding H¹ ⊂⊂ L² on the torus

macros.name: Adelic Identification (CRT torus = non-Archimedean projection of 𝔸)
sub_claims: NS evolution commutes with ℤ_p → ℤ/pℤ projections
adelic product formula + strong approximation ⇒ global bound

macros.name: L∞ Passes to Continuum via Piecewise-Constant Interpolation
sub_claims: piecewise-constant interpolation has zero L∞ overshoot
Banach-Alaoglu: bounded L∞ sequence has weak-* convergent subsequence
weak-* limit = strong L² limit from M4 (uniqueness)

macros.name: Nonlinear Passage (Lions 1969 distributional limit)
sub_claims: B1: ω_N bounded in L²(0,T; H¹) from M1
B2: ω_N bounded in L∞(0,T; L∞) from M2
B3: ∂_t ω_N bounded in L²(0,T; H⁻¹) from NS structure + B1 + B2
Biot-Savart L² → H¹ boundedness; u_N → u strongly in L²(L⁶)
bilinear term convergence via (u_N − u)·∇ω_N + u·∇(ω_N − ω) decomposition
Hölder estimate on each piece, taking N→∞
conclusion: ω satisfies NS equation in distributions

macros.name: BKM Regularity + Uniqueness
sub_claims: BKM criterion: finite integral ⇒ C^∞ regularity

macros.name: Three-Stream Structural Reinforcement
sub_claims: coprime bounded in L² from M1 + non-expansion

leaves.name: shift.sp_sn
leaves.lean_target: theorem sp_sn (i : Fin 8) : sp (sn i) = i
leaves.description_for_agent: sp i = i + 1, sn i = i + (N-1) in Fin N with N=8. Prove sp (sn i) = i for all i.

leaves.name: shift.sn_sp
leaves.lean_target: theorem sn_sp (i : Fin 8) : sn (sp i) = i

leaves.name: shift.sum_sp
leaves.lean_target: theorem sum_sp (f : Fin 8 → Int) : (List.finRange 8).foldl (fun a i => a + f (sp i)) 0 = (List.finRange 8).foldl (fun a i => a + f i) 0
leaves.description_for_agent: The sum over Fin 8 of f(sp i) equals the sum of f(i). This is shift-invariance under periodic reindex.

leaves.name: shift.sum_sn
leaves.lean_target: theorem sum_sn (f : Fin 8 → Int) : (List.finRange 8).foldl (fun a i => a + f (sn i)) 0 = (List.finRange 8).foldl (fun a i => a + f i) 0

leaves.name: sbp.x_1d
leaves.lean_target: theorem sbp_x_1d (u ω : Fin 8 → Int) : (Σ i, ω i * (u i * (ω (sp i) - ω (sn i)) + (u (sp i) * ω (sp i) - u (sn i) * ω (sn i)))) = 0
leaves.description_for_agent: 1D summation-by-parts. Expand the sum; apply sum_sp and sum_sn to reindex the 'conservative' part; pointwise cancellation with the 'advective' part yields 0.

leaves.name: sbp.y_1d
leaves.lean_target: theorem sbp_y_1d : (same as L1.5 but in y-direction, on a 2D slice)
leaves.description_for_agent: Symmetric to L1.5 in the y-direction. Agent may use L1.5 as a lemma after index swap.

leaves.name: sbp.z_1d
leaves.lean_target: theorem sbp_z_1d : (same as L1.5 but in z-direction)

leaves.name: sbp.component_zero
leaves.lean_target: theorem component_residual_zero (u : VField) (ωc : Grid) : sumGrid (fun i j k => ωc i j k * (advective u ωc i j k + conservative u ωc i j k)) = 0
leaves.description_for_agent: For a single vorticity component, the 3D energy residual is zero. Decompose the 3D sum into three 1D sums (one per direction). Apply L1.5, L1.6, L1.7.

leaves.name: kill_113
leaves.lean_target: theorem kill_113 (u ω : VField) : residual u ω = 0
leaves.description_for_agent: Sum three zeros (one per vorticity component x/y/z) using L1.8. Pure composition, no fresh math.
